title: Sleep Daily
description: Daily sleep context with explicit generation-boundary availability and review states. sleep_duration_minutes_ex_awake sums observed finite deep/light/REM stages when any are present; otherwise it uses only an agreed direct source alias when available, never fills missing stages with zero, never uses awake or window-minus-awake, and remains null when no authoritative value exists.

sleep_day_source.description: Starting with v2.0.0: the source field that gives sleep_day: calendarDate or, when it cannot be read, sleepEndTimestampGMT in the run's timezone.

sleep_duration_source.description: Starting with v2.0.0: how sleep_duration_minutes_ex_awake was made: stage_derived, direct_fallback, null_fallback, direct_aliases_disagree, or stage_aliases_disagree.

disagreeing_fields.description: Starting with v2.0.0: the fields of this row whose values differ between the observations of its stable key, in field order. Those fields are null, and the dataset's audit keeps every observed value. Empty when the observations agree.
